Team — quick summary and request: Alex Jensen completed the 60-day PIP last week. He missed the final checkpoint (no deliverable submitted, no calendar responses) and I couldn't get a one-on-one confirmed. I met with him briefly on Thursday; he was noncommittal about next steps and didn't propose a remediation plan.

Attached: final_pip_summary.pdf and device_inventory.csv (please update with asset tags).

Requesting HR/legal guidance on two things:
- If we should proceed with an involuntary separation vs. offer a voluntary resignation with a severance package (we prefer voluntary where plausible).
- If voluntary: recommended notice window and severance range for someone at his level (IC3, 3 years).
- If involuntary or voluntary-with-terms: timing for deprovisioning (Okta, GitHub, GCP service accounts) and payroll cutoff to avoid delays.

Karthik — are there any performance/legal flags we should be aware of before we finalize? Rishi — can you queue up a quick severance estimate? Monica — want HR to lead the outreach if we go voluntary.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Post-PIP next steps for Alex Jensen

Thanks for the summary. A few notes:
- Before we move to involuntary, HR prefers offering a voluntary separation where reasonable; it reduces litigation risk and speeds closure in many cases.
- If we do voluntary: standard practice for IC3 with 3 years is 4–8 weeks base pay + COBRA assistance. We can flex depending on notice and handoff.
- Please upload the signed employment_agreement.pdf and any prior PIP docs to the HR folder (I've attached the template we use).

I'll reach out to Alex on a private call this afternoon to gauge interest in voluntary terms. If he declines or becomes uncooperative, we'll document and proceed with an involuntary path and coordinated deprovisioning.

For access: please prepare an Okta revoke list and a GitHub org role map. Suggested default deprovision window for involuntary is immediate access removal + payroll adjustment same day (subject to payroll deadlines). If voluntary with notice, stagger access: code repos read-only, remove prod keys immediately.

-Monica
Monica Patel
Senior HR Business Partner, Redwood Inference
